answer_4.quote: We develop a rigorous annotation manual to assess the validity of those generations based on three criteria: soundness, informativeness, and relevance. We score each rationale for each criterion using a Likert scale of 1 to 3... answer_4.guideline: Annotators followed a step-by-step protocol: 1) Read dialogue history, utterance, and rationale; 2) Assign Soundness score based on perspective alignment; 3) Assign Informativeness score for accuracy and completeness; 4) Assign Relevance score for subtext capture.
